post_title: What will Japan's national average of influenza cases per sentinel medical institution be for the week ending October 25, 2026?

question.title: What will Japan's national average of influenza cases per sentinel medical institution be for the week ending October 25, 2026?
question.description:
Japan's Institute for Health Security (JIHS, formerly the National Institute of Infectious Diseases) runs a sentinel surveillance system in which roughly 3,000 designated medical institutions report weekly influenza patient counts. The headline metric is the national average number of cases per sentinel institution (定点当たり報告数). An "alert" level is 10 cases per sentinel and a "warning" level is 30. Reports are published weekly on Fridays in the Infectious Diseases Weekly Report (IDWR), covering the epidemiological week ending the preceding Sunday.

The 2026–2027 season started unusually early (around August, the second-earliest since 1999). The national per-sentinel average rose from 7.17 (week ending Sep 28) to 11.35 (week ending Oct 4, +58%) to 12.81 (week ending Oct 11, roughly +13%), showing rapid growth that was beginning to decelerate. As of early-to-mid October 2026, 28 prefectures were at or above the "alert" threshold of 10, and Okinawa had exceeded the "warning" threshold of 30. For comparison, in the 2025–2026 season the national average was only about 1.56 for the equivalent early-October week and did not reach ~14.9 until the week ending Nov 2, 2025.

The question concerns the reading for epidemiological week 44 of 2026 (the week ending Sunday, October 25, 2026), which JIHS is expected to publish on or around Friday, October 30, 2026. Because the trajectory depends on two further weekly readings (weeks ending Oct 18 and Oct 25) not yet published, the eventual value is genuinely uncertain: continued deceleration, a plateau, or a renewed acceleration are all plausible.

question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to the national average number of reported influenza cases per sentinel medical institution (定点当たり報告数) for epidemiological week 44 of 2026 (the week ending Sunday, October 25, 2026), as published by Japan's Institute for Health Security (JIHS) in the Infectious Diseases Weekly Report (IDWR). The figure is the single nationwide "cases per sentinel" value for influenza, expected to be published on or around Friday, October 30, 2026, in the week-44 surveillance data table at https://id-info.jihs.go.jp/en/surveillance/idwr/rapid/2026/index.html . For example, a reported national average of 14.90 cases per sentinel resolves as 14.90. If the figure is also available via the JIHS dashboard at https://www.jihs.go.jp/content10/030/en_Dashboard.html or reported by [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions), those may be used.
question.fine_print: If JIHS publishes a provisional week-44 value that is later revised, the first published national value for week 44 is used. If the week-44 figure is not published by any source by November 15, 2026, the question is annulled. Prefecture-level figures and hospital-based surveillance figures do not count; only the single nationwide per-sentinel average for influenza is used.
